title: RoomsFromLayer Command
description: Create planar room markers from closed curves on A-ROOM (layer room is an alias when the other name is missing). Source curves stay. Empty or missing layer returns count 0. Does not detect rooms from walls. Layer X-EXIST returns count 0: existing underlay is not a bake source.

layer.description: Source layer for closed room outlines (case-insensitive). Default A-ROOM. Name room resolves to A-ROOM when that layer is missing, and the reverse.

target_layer.description: Layer for new room markers. Created if missing. Default A-ROOM.

name_prefix.description: Name prefix for new markers (room-01, room-02, …). forsk:id is r01, r02, … in the same bake order.

join_tolerance.description: Join tolerance for open segments. Default is max(10× model tolerance, 1).
